outcome: Contribution of each Robson group to the overall cesarean section rate
cohort: 1,189,578 pregnant women who delivered in university hospitals, private hospitals and public hospitals in Türkiye in 2016
finding: The overall cesarean section rate in Türkiye in 2016 was 54.6%, with Robson Groups 1, 2, and 5 contributing significantly to the cesarean section burden.
mod_finding: The study found an overall cesarean section rate of 54.6% in Turkey in 2016, with the Robson Group 5 (previous cesarean section) contributing significantly to this rate.
